new-moon.label: New Moon
new-moon.body: A new cycle is taking shape. Clarifying your intention and organizing the conditions matters more now than rushing to see results.

waxing-crescent.label: Waxing Crescent
waxing-crescent.body: The direction is beginning to take shape, but small experiments are still needed to confirm which approaches are worth continuing.

first-quarter.label: First Quarter
first-quarter.body: Action and resistance are increasing together. The friction that appears as you move forward will help clarify the decision that truly needs to be made.

waxing-gibbous.label: Waxing Gibbous
waxing-gibbous.body: The situation is close to taking full form. This is a better time to refine, correct, and fill gaps than to start over.

full-moon.label: Full Moon
full-moon.body: Results, reactions, and relationship dynamics are becoming easier to see. Confirm the facts, then decide what needs to change next.

waning-gibbous.label: Waning Gibbous
waning-gibbous.body: The focus shifts to understanding what has already happened and turning the experience into something you can share or continue to use.

last-quarter.label: Last Quarter
last-quarter.body: This phase calls for adjustment and selection. An honest assessment of what still works will help more than forcing an outdated approach to continue.

waning-crescent.label: Waning Crescent
waning-crescent.body: Energy is gradually turning inward. Rest, close unfinished matters, and make room for the next beginning.

sun.direct: Visibility and purpose continue moving forward.

moon.direct: The emotional tone changes quickly and remains time-sensitive.

mercury.direct: Thinking and communication are moving forward.
mercury.retrograde: A good time to review messages, documents, schedules, and decisions that have not yet been finalized.

venus.direct: Connection, values and attraction are moving forward.
venus.retrograde: A good time to reassess relationships, preferences, prices, and value-based trade-offs.

mars.direct: Action and motivation are moving forward.
mars.retrograde: The pace of action may slow. Adjust your strategy, address old conflicts, and redistribute your energy.

jupiter.direct: Growth and opportunity are moving forward.
jupiter.retrograde: Expansion slows, creating space to check whether your plans, beliefs, and resources still match.

saturn.direct: Responsibility and structure are moving forward.
saturn.retrograde: Long-term responsibilities, rules, and commitments enter a review phase. Structures that no longer work need revision.

uranus.direct: Change and experimentation are moving forward.
uranus.retrograde: Change is happening more internally. Reconsider which limits genuinely need to be broken.

neptune.direct: Imagination and sensitivity are moving forward.
neptune.retrograde: Ideals, boundaries, and assumptions need to be verified again. Avoid making important decisions on feeling alone.

pluto.direct: Power and transformation are moving forward.
pluto.retrograde: Control, attachment, and deep change enter an internal processing phase; external results may remain unclear for now.

trueNode.direct: The lunar node is moving direct, briefly emphasizing forward movement in long-term developmental themes.
trueNode.retrograde: The lunar node is moving retrograde, its usual motion, emphasizing gradual long-term development rather than an immediate event.

aries.headline: Direct emotional honesty
aries.body: You feel safer when feelings can move quickly, be named plainly and lead to immediate action.

taurus.headline: Stability and sensory calm
taurus.body: You feel safer with consistency, physical comfort and enough time to process change before responding.

gemini.headline: Conversation and mental movement
gemini.body: You feel safer when you can ask questions, name different possibilities and keep information moving.

cancer.headline: Familiarity and emotional protection
cancer.body: You feel safer when care is visible, privacy is respected and close bonds feel dependable.

leo.headline: Warmth and heartfelt recognition
leo.body: You feel safer when affection is expressed openly and your emotional presence is genuinely appreciated.

virgo.headline: Order and useful support
virgo.body: You feel safer when needs can be handled practically, routines are clear and small problems are addressed.

libra.headline: Reciprocity and relational balance
libra.body: You feel safer when both sides are heard and emotional exchanges remain fair, calm and responsive.

scorpio.headline: Depth and emotional truth
scorpio.body: You feel safer when trust is earned, motives are honest and difficult feelings are not avoided.

sagittarius.headline: Space and renewed perspective
sagittarius.body: You feel safer when emotions can breathe, meaning can be found and the future still feels open.

capricorn.headline: Reliability and emotional self-command
capricorn.body: You feel safer when responsibilities are clear, promises are kept and feelings can be handled steadily.

aquarius.headline: Freedom and emotional perspective
aquarius.body: You feel safer when connection allows individuality, honest thought and room to step back before reacting.

pisces.headline: Gentleness and emotional permeability
pisces.body: You feel safer with compassion, imagination and enough quiet to separate your feelings from the surrounding atmosphere.

loveElementMatrix.air.earth: You connect when ideas remain flexible but promises, routines and responsibilities stay dependable.
loveElementMatrix.air.air: You connect through mental rapport, friendship and enough personal space for both people to stay fully themselves.

loveElementMatrix.water.air: You connect when emotional sensitivity is translated into words and neither person has to guess for too long.
loveElementMatrix.water.water: You connect through empathy, intuition and a strong need for emotional honesty and protected closeness.

aries.headline: Lead through initiative
aries.body: Public contribution grows through decisive action, visible ownership and the willingness to begin before every answer is available.

taurus.headline: Build what can last
taurus.body: Public contribution grows through consistency, practical value and patient development rather than constant reinvention.

gemini.headline: Connect ideas and people
gemini.body: Public contribution grows through communication, adaptability and the ability to translate information for different audiences.

cancer.headline: Create trust and continuity
cancer.body: Public contribution grows through care, protection and an instinct for what people need in order to feel supported.

leo.headline: Make the work visible
leo.body: Public contribution grows through creative leadership, confident presentation and the courage to stand behind what you make.

virgo.headline: Turn complexity into useful systems
virgo.body: Public contribution grows through analysis, precise improvement and work that makes everyday processes more reliable.

libra.headline: Build alignment across differences
libra.body: Public contribution grows through negotiation, design and the ability to create workable balance between competing needs.

scorpio.headline: Work where depth and consequence matter
scorpio.body: Public contribution grows through investigation, strategic focus and the ability to handle pressure without avoiding what is difficult.

sagittarius.headline: Expand the field of possibility
sagittarius.body: Public contribution grows through teaching, exploration and work that connects immediate tasks with a larger direction.

capricorn.headline: Carry visible responsibility
capricorn.body: Public contribution grows through discipline, structure and the ability to build authority through sustained results.

aquarius.headline: Design better systems
aquarius.body: Public contribution grows through independent thinking, experimentation and solutions that improve how groups or networks function.

pisces.headline: Give form to imagination and care
pisces.body: Public contribution grows through intuition, creativity and work that makes subtle human needs easier to recognize.

quiet.headline: A quieter sky with room to reset
quiet.body: Fewer exact contacts make the overall atmosphere less demanding and easier to use for maintenance, reflection and recovery.

supportive.headline: A more cooperative sky
supportive.body: Supportive contacts make it easier to connect ideas, people and practical next steps without forcing momentum.

challenging.headline: A sky that asks for better pacing
challenging.body: Tighter pressure patterns increase friction, making clarity, timing and emotional regulation more important.

mixed.headline: Support and pressure are both active
mixed.body: Some areas move more easily while others require restraint, so prioritization matters more than a single overall mood.

fast.headline: A fast-moving sky
fast.body: Short-lived contacts and lunar changes make the atmosphere responsive, changeable and sensitive to timing.

review.headline: A review-heavy sky
review.body: Several retrograde or stationing bodies keep attention on revision, unfinished business and better sequencing.

active.headline: Communication needs more patience

coming.headline: Conversations require more care

active.headline: Communication flows more easily
active.body: It is easier to explain an idea, ask the right question or find common language.

coming.headline: A useful conversation is opening
coming.body: New information or a constructive exchange begins to gather momentum.

chapter.body: A complicated situation becomes easier to organize once the central fact is separated from surrounding noise.

active.headline: The next step is easier to see
active.body: A decision or explanation can become simpler when you focus on the strongest evidence.

coming.headline: Clarity is building
coming.body: A confusing issue begins to organize itself into a more workable direction.

chapter.headline: Revising the way you interpret the situation
chapter.body: This period favors checking assumptions, reopening unfinished questions and correcting information before moving ahead.

active.headline: Pause before finalizing the message
active.body: A second look may reveal a missing detail or a better way to phrase the point.

coming.headline: A review phase is approaching
coming.body: Old information, unfinished communication or a previous decision may return for adjustment.

chapter.headline: More room for connection and reciprocity
chapter.body: Relationships can become easier to approach when interest is expressed clearly and expectations stay proportionate.

active.headline: Relationships become more open
active.body: Warmth, cooperation or attraction is easier to exchange without forcing the outcome.

coming.headline: A relational opening is developing
coming.body: Venusian themes of connection, agreement or attraction begin to receive more support.

chapter.headline: Defining what a relationship can reliably hold
chapter.body: This period asks for clearer expectations, steadier agreements and less reliance on unspoken assumptions.

active.headline: Relationships need clearer limits
active.body: A boundary, commitment or difference in expectations may need to be stated directly.

coming.headline: A relationship test is approaching
coming.body: A connection may ask for greater reliability, patience or a more realistic agreement.

chapter.headline: Facing the deeper terms of connection
chapter.body: Attachment, trust and power become more visible, making emotional honesty more useful than surface reassurance.

active.headline: Connection feels more intense
active.body: A strong reaction may reveal what matters, what feels threatened or what needs to change.

coming.headline: A deeper relational phase is building
coming.body: Attraction, trust or control themes begin to gather more psychological weight.

chapter.headline: Making room for closeness without losing individuality
chapter.body: This period encourages more honest space, fresher agreements and less dependence on rigid relational roles.

active.headline: Relationships need more breathing room
active.body: A connection works better today when both people have space to respond honestly.

coming.headline: A change in relationship rhythm is approaching
coming.body: New terms, unexpected attraction or a greater need for independence may soon become visible.

chapter.headline: Strengthening emotional continuity
chapter.body: This period supports calmer processing, reliable support and choices that protect what genuinely helps you stay grounded.

active.headline: Emotional steadiness is easier to access
active.body: A familiar rhythm or supportive exchange can help you respond without unnecessary urgency.

coming.headline: A steadier emotional phase is approaching
coming.body: Support, reassurance or a calmer rhythm begins to replace recent uncertainty.

chapter.headline: Listening more carefully to emotional atmosphere
chapter.body: This period heightens receptivity, imagination and empathy, while also making boundaries and recovery time more important.

active.headline: Feelings are more sensitive today
active.body: You may notice tone, implication and other people’s moods more strongly than usual.

coming.headline: A more sensitive phase is approaching
coming.body: Emotional and intuitive signals begin to carry more weight, so leave room for rest and clarification.

chapter.headline: Redefining emotional security
chapter.body: Familiar patterns around home, belonging or stability may no longer feel sufficient, creating room for a more flexible emotional life.

active.headline: Emotional routines are changing quickly
active.body: A familiar reaction may no longer fit, and forcing the old pattern can create more tension.

coming.headline: An emotional shift is approaching
coming.body: A change in home, mood or attachment patterns begins to gather momentum.

chapter.headline: Building a more durable form of emotional security
chapter.body: This period asks for patience with heavier feelings, clearer responsibility and support that can be relied on over time.

active.headline: Feelings may take more effort to process
active.body: Emotional restraint or responsibility can feel heavier today, so use simple and dependable support.

coming.headline: A more serious emotional phase is approaching
coming.body: Questions of trust, duty or emotional availability begin to require clearer answers.

chapter.headline: Expanding confidence without losing proportion
chapter.body: This period supports visibility, optimism and a larger sense of possibility when enthusiasm remains connected to real capacity.

active.headline: Confidence is easier to access
active.body: A broader perspective can help you act with more generosity and less hesitation.

coming.headline: A confidence-building opening is approaching
coming.body: Recognition, opportunity or a larger role begins to move within reach.

chapter.headline: Rewriting the terms of self-expression
chapter.body: This period loosens old definitions and encourages a more independent, experimental and honest way of showing up.

active.headline: You may want to do things differently
active.body: A sudden preference or stronger need for independence can reveal where an old role has become too narrow.

coming.headline: A personal reinvention is beginning
coming.body: A new way of presenting yourself or directing your life starts to take shape.

chapter.headline: Rebuilding identity from a deeper level
chapter.body: This period exposes what no longer feels authentic and asks for choices with greater psychological honesty and personal power.

active.headline: A deeper personal truth is harder to ignore
active.body: A strong reaction may show where control, fear or outdated self-definition needs to change.

coming.headline: A major identity shift is developing
coming.body: A more consequential phase of self-definition, power and renewal begins to gather force.

chapter.body: This period tests timing, confidence and endurance, but it can also clarify what deserves long-term commitment.

active.headline: Responsibilities feel more visible
active.body: Limits, deadlines or expectations may require a steadier pace and fewer unnecessary promises.

coming.headline: A demanding responsibility is approaching
coming.body: A role, boundary or long-term obligation begins to require more structure.

chapter.headline: Turning effort into something durable
chapter.body: This period supports patient construction, clearer standards and progress that can survive beyond immediate enthusiasm.

active.headline: Steady work matters more than speed
active.body: A practical step, repeated carefully, can produce more value than a dramatic push.

coming.headline: A more structured phase is beginning
coming.body: Plans, duties or commitments start to take a clearer and more sustainable form.

chapter.headline: Learning how to work with resistance
chapter.body: This period asks for better timing, controlled effort and a distinction between necessary persistence and wasted force.

active.headline: Pushing harder may not help
active.body: A delay or limit can show where the method needs adjustment rather than more pressure.

coming.headline: A test of timing is approaching
coming.body: Action may meet a constraint that requires patience, strategy or a different route.

chapter.body: This period supports decisive movement, courage and larger effort when energy is directed toward a clear aim.

active.body: A task can move quickly when you choose one priority and act before momentum disperses.

coming.headline: A more active phase is beginning
coming.body: Motivation, initiative or competition starts to increase.

chapter.body: This period brings attention to private life, family patterns and the conditions that make emotional recovery possible.

coming.headline: A home-related shift is approaching

chapter.body: This period supports recognition, clearer responsibility and work that places your abilities in a more public context.

active.body: A task, conversation or decision can improve how others understand your role.

coming.headline: A career opening is approaching

chapter.body: This period asks you to reconsider role, authority and the systems through which your work creates value.

active.body: A responsibility or expectation may need to be reduced, reassigned or stated more precisely.

coming.headline: A professional turning point is approaching
coming.body: A role, hierarchy or long-term direction begins to change shape.

chapter.body: This period favors clearer spending, stronger boundaries and choices based on durable value rather than immediate reassurance.

active.body: Check the practical terms before committing, especially where urgency or emotion is shaping the choice.

coming.headline: A financial review is approaching
coming.body: Income, spending, pricing or shared-resource questions may return for adjustment.

chapter.headline: Clarifying what still deserves commitment
chapter.body: This period reveals where preferences, loyalties or material choices no longer match current priorities.

active.headline: A value judgment may be changing
active.body: What felt attractive or worthwhile before may need a more honest reassessment today.

coming.headline: A change in priorities is approaching
coming.body: Relationship, money or aesthetic choices begin to reflect a different standard.

chapter.headline: Redesigning everyday systems
chapter.body: This period exposes routines that are too rigid, inefficient or disconnected from current needs.

active.headline: The usual routine may not hold
active.body: A schedule or workflow may need a faster adjustment than expected.

coming.headline: A routine change is approaching
coming.body: Work habits, health practices or daily logistics begin to move into a new pattern.

chapter.headline: Integrating what has already changed
chapter.body: This period supports recovery, emotional digestion and the gradual return of choice after a demanding transition.

active.headline: A calmer response is available
active.body: You may be able to notice what has improved without reopening the entire problem.

coming.headline: A more integrated phase is approaching
coming.body: Recent changes begin to settle into a form that feels easier to live with.

chapter.headline: Giving useful form to imagination
chapter.body: This period supports creativity, empathy and intuitive understanding when inspiration is paired with enough structure.

active.headline: Imagination is more available
active.body: A subtle idea, image or emotional impression may point toward a useful next step.

coming.headline: A creative opening is approaching
coming.body: Inspiration, compassion or artistic sensitivity begins to gather momentum.

chapter.headline: Separating intuition from assumption
chapter.body: This period increases sensitivity and imagination, but it also requires clearer evidence, boundaries and recovery time.

active.headline: The situation may be harder to read
active.body: Avoid forcing certainty where information is incomplete or emotions are unusually porous.

coming.headline: A less certain phase is approaching
coming.body: Mixed signals, idealization or incomplete information may require a slower response.

chapter.headline: Widening the field of connection
chapter.body: This period supports community, collaboration and plans that become more possible through other people.

active.headline: Social support is easier to access
active.body: A group, friend or shared plan may offer useful momentum today.

coming.headline: A wider network is opening
coming.body: New contacts, invitations or collective opportunities begin to develop.

chapter.headline: Clarifying your role within the group
chapter.body: This period asks for more realistic expectations around friendship, community and shared responsibility.

active.headline: A group dynamic needs clearer limits
active.body: You may need to define what you can contribute without carrying the whole structure.

coming.headline: A social responsibility is approaching
coming.body: A friendship, team or future plan begins to require firmer terms.

chapter.headline: Expanding through greater independence
chapter.body: This period rewards experimentation, original choices and a willingness to move beyond inherited assumptions.

active.headline: An independent choice is easier to make
active.body: A new method or less conventional answer may fit better than the familiar one.

coming.headline: A freer direction is approaching
coming.body: A change in method, role or self-definition begins to create more room.

chapter.headline: Making commitment more deliberate
chapter.body: This period favors agreements that are explicit, realistic and strong enough to carry responsibility.

active.headline: Commitment is measured through action
active.body: A promise or relationship gains credibility through one concrete and dependable step.

coming.headline: A commitment decision is approaching
coming.body: A relationship, role or long-term plan begins to require a clearer yes, no or condition.

chapter.headline: Releasing a structure that has completed its purpose
chapter.body: This period makes it harder to preserve an old pattern simply because it once provided control or certainty.

active.body: A strong reaction can reveal where holding on now costs more than changing.

coming.headline: A deeper release is approaching
coming.body: An attachment, role or control pattern begins to lose its previous hold.

chapter.headline: Opening a wider field of learning and meaning
chapter.body: This period supports study, travel, teaching and ideas that reorganize the larger direction of life.

active.headline: A wider perspective helps today
active.body: New information or a broader frame can make the immediate issue easier to understand.

coming.headline: A learning opportunity is approaching
coming.body: Study, travel, publishing or a new worldview begins to gain momentum.

chapter.headline: Developing a more honest basis for trust
chapter.body: This period brings shared resources, intimacy and emotional risk into clearer focus.

active.body: A financial or emotional agreement works better when expectations are explicit.

coming.headline: A deeper trust question is approaching
coming.body: Shared resources, intimacy or vulnerability begin to require a more honest exchange.

chapter.body: This period favors responding seriously to opportunities that can support lasting growth, rather than simply preserving what feels familiar and safe.

active.body: A decision, conversation, or action is showing what deserves continued investment.

coming.headline: A new path for development is taking shape
coming.body: People, information, or opportunities appearing soon may help you enter the next stage.

active.body: Pause and check whether your immediate reaction is solving the problem or only preserving familiarity.

coming.headline: A change of direction is approaching
coming.body: New conditions will ask you to reassess priorities and release some older arrangements.

chapter.body: Some choices will have longer consequences than expected. Judge them by whether they support lasting growth, not short-term comfort.

active.headline: An ordinary-looking decision may be pivotal
active.body: Notice which choices open space for what comes next and which ones only return you to an old cycle.

coming.headline: A key turning point is approaching
coming.body: Events in the near future may clarify your long-term direction and may also require a meaningful trade-off.

new.headline: A new developmental cycle

review.headline: A phase of visibility and review
review.body: The consequences of earlier choices are easier to see, making adjustment and honest evaluation more important.

integration.headline: A phase of integration and release
integration.body: The emphasis shifts toward consolidation, completion and preparation for a different developmental direction.

gemini.headline: A year of movement, learning and exchange
gemini.body: The year favors communication, changing perspectives and useful contact across several areas of life.

libra.body: The year favors partnership, agreement and choices shaped by mutual consequence.

scorpio.body: The year favors psychological honesty, strategic change and more deliberate handling of power or shared resources.

sagittarius.body: The year favors study, travel, teaching and decisions that open a larger horizon.

capricorn.headline: A year of responsibility and durable achievement
capricorn.body: The year favors structure, authority and progress built through sustained effort.

aquarius.headline: A year of experimentation and future-oriented change
aquarius.body: The year favors networks, innovation and a more independent relationship with established expectations.

pisces.headline: A year of sensitivity, imagination and release
pisces.body: The year favors creativity, compassion and clearer boundaries around what you absorb or carry.

1.label: Establish the year
1.body: The first quarter reveals the immediate priorities and conditions that set the annual tone.

2.label: Develop the main effort
2.body: The second quarter increases activity around the year’s central responsibilities and opportunities.

3.label: Review visible results
3.body: The third quarter makes outcomes, pressure points and necessary adjustments easier to identify.

4.label: Consolidate and prepare
4.body: The final quarter supports completion, integration and preparation for the next return cycle.

supportive-balanced.headline: A relationship with natural areas of cooperation
supportive-balanced.body: Several key contacts support understanding, reciprocity and the ability to work with differences without constant repair.

supportive-intense.headline: Strong attraction with real developmental potential
supportive-intense.body: The connection carries warmth and momentum, while deeper contacts make honesty and responsibility important.

challenging-growth.headline: A relationship that develops through active adjustment
challenging-growth.body: The connection can be meaningful, but differences in timing, need or communication require deliberate coordination.

challenging-intense.headline: A powerful bond that needs clear boundaries
challenging-intense.body: Attraction and emotional consequence are strong, making trust, consent and power-sharing central to the relationship.

mixed.headline: A relationship with both ease and friction
mixed.body: Some parts of the connection flow naturally while others repeatedly ask for clarification, patience or renegotiation.

quiet.headline: A relationship shaped more by context than constant intensity
quiet.body: The chart shows fewer dominant contacts, so shared choices and lived circumstances may matter more than immediate chemistry.

houseOverlay.1: This person strongly activates identity, self-awareness and immediate personal response.
houseOverlay.2: This person activates money, values, security and questions of personal worth.
houseOverlay.3: This person activates communication, learning and the rhythm of everyday contact.
houseOverlay.4: This person activates home, family memory and the private emotional foundation.
houseOverlay.5: This person activates attraction, play, creativity and the desire to be personally expressive.
houseOverlay.6: This person activates routines, practical support, work habits and everyday responsibility.
houseOverlay.7: This person activates partnership, agreement and the experience of meeting an equal other.
houseOverlay.8: This person activates trust, intimacy, shared resources and deeper emotional consequence.
houseOverlay.9: This person activates belief, learning, travel and a wider view of what life can mean.
houseOverlay.10: This person activates career, visibility, ambition and public responsibility.
houseOverlay.11: This person activates friendship, community and plans for the future.
houseOverlay.12: This person activates private feeling, projection, rest and material that is difficult to name directly.

policy.description: The modern preset uses outer planets, modern rulerships, major aspects, and psychological and everyday-life interpretations.
policy.outerPlanets: Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto participate in chart-ruler, dominant-planet, aspect, and theme evaluation.
policy.trueNode: trueNode participates in placement, aspect, transit, and progressed turning-point analysis as a point of development, but it cannot serve as the chart ruler.

chartRulerCopy.sun: You tend to make choices according to your own will. Setting goals, expressing yourself, and receiving recognition are important sources of motivation.
chartRulerCopy.moon: You usually sense the environment before deciding how to respond. Security, familiarity, and emotional connection strongly influence your choices.
chartRulerCopy.mercury: When you meet a new situation, you tend to observe, ask questions, and organize the information first. Clear thinking and smooth communication directly affect how you act.
chartRulerCopy.venus: You tend to begin by deciding what feels comfortable, harmonious, and worthwhile. The quality of a relationship, aesthetic fit, and mutual compatibility matter greatly to you.
chartRulerCopy.mars: You prefer to confirm direction through action. When a problem appears, you usually move first, respond directly, and pursue the outcome you want.
chartRulerCopy.jupiter: You are easily drawn to room for growth and larger possibilities. Learning, exploring, and searching for meaning often lead you toward new opportunities.
chartRulerCopy.saturn: You tend to make decisions carefully and are willing to take responsibility for long-term results. Clear rules, order, and steady accumulation help you feel grounded.
chartRulerCopy.uranus: You need to live in your own way. When faced with restrictions, you look for a different path and are willing to try choices outside convention.
chartRulerCopy.neptune: You are sensitive to atmosphere, emotion, and subtle shifts. Intuition and imagination influence your judgment, while clear boundaries help you confirm your direction.
chartRulerCopy.pluto: Surface answers rarely satisfy you. When something matters, you tend to investigate deeply, understand the power dynamics, and create change through sustained adjustment.

bodyTheme.mercury: Thinking, communication, and ways of understanding
bodyTheme.venus: Relationships, values, and ways of attracting
bodyTheme.jupiter: Growth, belief, and assessment of opportunity
bodyTheme.uranus: Independence, breakthroughs, and ways of changing
bodyTheme.neptune: Imagination, empathy, and a sense of boundaries
bodyTheme.pluto: Power, deep psychology, and fundamental change
bodyTheme.trueNode: Long-term growth direction and pivotal choices

fire.cardinal.headline: Quick to act, direct in response, and willing to take the first step
fire.cardinal.body: You rarely wait long for complete certainty. Once an instinct forms, you tend to test it immediately and adjust your direction based on the result.

fire.fixed.headline: Strong enthusiasm and the power to carry something through
fire.fixed.body: You value self-respect and personal expression. Once you commit to a goal, you are willing to keep investing and want your effort to be recognized.

fire.mutable.headline: Exploration keeps you energized, and your perspective needs room to expand
fire.mutable.body: New knowledge, environments, and possibilities quickly spark your interest. You are better suited to discovering direction through action than defining yourself too early.

earth.cardinal.headline: Practical in approach and accustomed to turning goals into concrete plans
earth.cardinal.body: You tend to clarify responsibilities, resources, and timing before moving ahead. Visible progress and measurable results strengthen your confidence.

earth.fixed.headline: Steady in pace, committed to reliability, and slow to reverse a decision
earth.fixed.body: Consistency and patience help you build security. When something proves itself over time, you are usually willing to invest for the long term.

earth.mutable.headline: Good at spotting problems and making complex matters more workable
earth.mutable.body: You are sensitive to detail and efficiency, and you regain a sense of control by adjusting methods, improving processes, and solving practical problems.

air.cardinal.headline: Skilled at opening dialogue and actively seeking a fairer solution
air.cardinal.body: You are used to understanding a problem from several positions and moving things forward through communication. Whether a relationship feels balanced strongly affects your decisions.

air.fixed.headline: Independent in thought, steady in judgment, and willing to stand by your principles
air.fixed.body: You value logic and long-range thinking and are not easily pushed into changing your position. Better systems and stronger evidence are what usually persuade you.

air.mutable.headline: Quick to observe and learn, with an ability to shift perspective rapidly
air.mutable.body: You are good at gathering information, connecting different viewpoints, and finding new explanations as conditions change. Keeping options open helps you stay energized.

water.cardinal.headline: Emotionally perceptive and ready to protect important people and relationships
water.cardinal.body: You usually notice changes in atmosphere early and instinctively work to preserve security, meet needs, or protect your private sphere.

water.fixed.headline: Deep-feeling, cautious with trust, and unlikely to withdraw lightly once committed
water.fixed.body: You carry a strong emotional memory of relationships and commitments. Once trust is genuinely established, you show considerable loyalty and resilience.

water.mutable.headline: Sensitive, adaptable, and easily affected by the surrounding atmosphere
water.mutable.body: You quickly pick up other people's emotions and what remains unspoken. Quiet, creative work, and clear boundaries help you stay steady.

balanced.cardinal.headline: Willing to begin and able to call on different strengths as the situation requires
balanced.cardinal.body: You do not rely on a single way of responding. You can push ahead when action is needed and adjust the pace when coordination matters.

balanced.fixed.headline: Able to sustain commitment without depending on one form of control
balanced.fixed.body: You can hold on to an important goal while maintaining stability from several angles, making you less likely to be carried away by short-term fluctuations.

balanced.mutable.headline: Quick to adapt while keeping several possibilities open
balanced.mutable.body: You are willing to update your views and methods and are not easily confined by one identity or answer.

balanced.mixed.headline: A layered temperament whose most visible side depends on the setting
balanced.mixed.body: No single element or mode remains dominant in every situation. You may present quite differently across contexts, which also gives you a broad range of responses.

sun.aries: Identity develops through initiative, directness and the willingness to begin.
sun.taurus: Identity develops through steadiness, self-possession and the creation of lasting value.
sun.gemini: Identity develops through curiosity, exchange and the freedom to keep learning.
sun.cancer: Identity develops through care, memory and the protection of what feels personally meaningful.
sun.leo: Identity develops through creative visibility, pride and wholehearted self-expression.
sun.virgo: Identity develops through usefulness, discernment and the steady improvement of real systems.
sun.libra: Identity develops through relationship, proportion and the ability to hold more than one perspective.
sun.scorpio: Identity develops through depth, resilience and the courage to face what others avoid.
sun.sagittarius: Identity develops through exploration, conviction and the pursuit of a wider horizon.
sun.capricorn: Identity develops through responsibility, mastery and visible long-term achievement.
sun.aquarius: Identity develops through independent ideas, social perspective and unconventional solutions.
sun.pisces: Identity develops through imagination, compassion and sensitivity to subtle experience.

moon.aries: Emotions move quickly and need honest, immediate expression.
moon.taurus: Emotional steadiness grows through comfort, rhythm and reliable sensory grounding.
moon.gemini: Feelings become easier to process when they can be named, compared and discussed.
moon.cancer: Emotional security depends strongly on familiarity, care and protected belonging.
moon.leo: Feelings seek warmth, recognition and enough room for heartfelt expression.
moon.virgo: Emotional regulation improves through order, practical support and manageable routines.
moon.libra: Emotional balance depends on reciprocity, fairness and a calm relational atmosphere.
moon.scorpio: Feelings run deep and require trust, privacy and emotional honesty.
moon.sagittarius: Emotional renewal comes through space, meaning and a sense of future possibility.
moon.capricorn: Feelings are handled carefully and often expressed through responsibility or dependable action.
moon.aquarius: Emotional processing needs perspective, freedom and room to remain individually defined.
moon.pisces: Feelings are highly receptive and benefit from compassion, imagination and clear energetic boundaries.

mercury.aries: Thinking is fast, direct and strongest when decisions can move into action.
mercury.taurus: Thinking is deliberate, practical and strongest when ideas can be tested against reality.
mercury.gemini: Thinking is agile, comparative and energized by constant information exchange.
mercury.cancer: Thinking is contextual, memory-based and attentive to emotional tone.
mercury.leo: Thinking is expressive, confident and inclined to communicate with personal conviction.
mercury.virgo: Thinking is precise, analytical and skilled at finding useful distinctions.
mercury.libra: Thinking is relational, balanced and alert to competing arguments.
mercury.scorpio: Thinking is probing, strategic and unwilling to stop at surface explanations.
mercury.sagittarius: Thinking is broad, interpretive and oriented toward principles or larger meaning.
mercury.capricorn: Thinking is structured, economical and focused on workable conclusions.
mercury.aquarius: Thinking is conceptual, independent and drawn toward systems-level patterns.
mercury.pisces: Thinking is associative, imaginative and responsive to implication more than strict sequence.

venus.aries: Affection is expressed through initiative, direct interest and visible desire.
venus.taurus: Affection is expressed through steadiness, touch, comfort and reliable presence.
venus.gemini: Affection is expressed through conversation, curiosity and shared mental movement.
venus.cancer: Affection is expressed through care, protection and the creation of emotional familiarity.
venus.leo: Affection is expressed warmly, visibly and with a strong need for wholehearted response.
venus.virgo: Affection is expressed through practical help, attentiveness and small acts of reliability.
venus.libra: Affection is expressed through reciprocity, tact and the desire to create mutual balance.
venus.scorpio: Affection is expressed through depth, loyalty and an expectation of emotional truth.
venus.sagittarius: Affection is expressed through openness, shared adventure and room to keep growing.
venus.capricorn: Affection is expressed through commitment, consistency and respect for what can endure.
venus.aquarius: Affection is expressed through friendship, individuality and respect for personal freedom.
venus.pisces: Affection is expressed through tenderness, empathy and imaginative emotional connection.

mars.aries: Action is immediate, competitive and energized by clear challenges.
mars.taurus: Action is persistent, measured and difficult to redirect once momentum is established.
mars.gemini: Action is quick, verbal and distributed across several interests at once.
mars.cancer: Action is protective, emotionally motivated and strongest when something personal is at stake.
mars.leo: Action is visible, proud and fueled by creative confidence or recognition.
mars.virgo: Action is precise, efficient and directed toward fixing what is not working.
mars.libra: Action develops through comparison, negotiation and awareness of other people’s responses.
mars.scorpio: Action is concentrated, strategic and capable of sustained pressure.
mars.sagittarius: Action is adventurous, candid and energized by a larger goal.
mars.capricorn: Action is disciplined, controlled and oriented toward long-term results.
mars.aquarius: Action is independent, experimental and willing to challenge established methods.
mars.pisces: Action is intuitive, indirect and strongest when guided by imagination or compassion.

jupiter.aries: Growth comes through initiative, courage and learning by direct experience.
jupiter.taurus: Growth comes through patience, practical development and confidence in steady accumulation.
jupiter.gemini: Growth comes through information, conversation and exposure to multiple viewpoints.
jupiter.cancer: Growth comes through care, belonging and the expansion of emotional or family roots.
jupiter.leo: Growth comes through creative confidence, visibility and generous self-expression.
jupiter.virgo: Growth comes through skill, service and the improvement of useful methods.
jupiter.libra: Growth comes through partnership, diplomacy and the ability to build mutual advantage.
jupiter.scorpio: Growth comes through depth, psychological honesty and the willingness to transform.
jupiter.sagittarius: Growth comes through exploration, belief and direct contact with wider horizons.
jupiter.capricorn: Growth comes through responsibility, strategy and respect for long-term structure.
jupiter.aquarius: Growth comes through networks, innovation and ideas that extend beyond individual interests.
jupiter.pisces: Growth comes through compassion, imagination and trust in meanings that cannot always be measured.

saturn.aries: Maturity develops through disciplined initiative and learning when force helps or hinders.
saturn.taurus: Maturity develops through patience, resource management and the slow building of security.
saturn.gemini: Maturity develops through careful language, disciplined study and responsibility for information.
saturn.cancer: Maturity develops through emotional boundaries, family responsibility and the creation of inner stability.
saturn.leo: Maturity develops through accountable self-expression and confidence that does not depend on constant applause.
saturn.virgo: Maturity develops through craft, precision and sustainable standards of usefulness.
saturn.libra: Maturity develops through fair agreements, relational accountability and durable reciprocity.
saturn.scorpio: Maturity develops through trust, shared power and the responsible handling of emotional intensity.
saturn.sagittarius: Maturity develops through tested beliefs, intellectual discipline and responsibility for one’s conclusions.
saturn.capricorn: Maturity develops through structure, endurance and the patient assumption of authority.
saturn.aquarius: Maturity develops through principled independence and responsibility to the wider system.
saturn.pisces: Maturity develops through compassionate boundaries, realism and disciplined use of imagination.

uranus.aries: You tend to break through limits through quick action and self-directed decisions, but you also need to avoid cutting off options too early simply to prove your independence.
uranus.taurus: Change challenges established values, material habits and definitions of security.
uranus.gemini: Change moves through language, information networks and rapidly shifting viewpoints.
uranus.cancer: Change unsettles familiar emotional patterns and inherited ideas of safety.
uranus.leo: Change demands freer creative expression and a less conventional relationship with visibility.
uranus.virgo: Change enters through work systems, health routines and the redesign of practical methods.
uranus.libra: Change reshapes agreements, expectations and the balance between closeness and autonomy.
uranus.scorpio: Change exposes hidden power structures and accelerates deep emotional transformation.
uranus.sagittarius: Change expands horizons through new beliefs, technologies or unfamiliar perspectives.
uranus.capricorn: Change disrupts established authority and forces structural modernization.
uranus.aquarius: Change is conceptual, collective and strongly oriented toward experimentation.
uranus.pisces: Change dissolves rigid categories and opens unfamiliar intuitive or imaginative pathways.

neptune.aries: Imagination seeks direct expression but may blur the line between impulse and inspiration.
neptune.taurus: Imagination attaches to beauty, comfort and ideals of material or emotional security.
neptune.gemini: Imagination works through language and association but requires care with ambiguity or projection.
neptune.cancer: Imagination is emotionally receptive and strongly influenced by memory, family and atmosphere.
neptune.leo: Imagination seeks creative visibility and can idealize recognition, romance or self-expression.
neptune.virgo: Imagination enters practical life, where sensitivity needs clear methods and realistic boundaries.
neptune.libra: Imagination colors relationship ideals and increases sensitivity to harmony, beauty and projection.
neptune.scorpio: Imagination moves through depth, secrecy and powerful emotional symbolism.
neptune.sagittarius: Imagination seeks meaning, faith and a unifying story that can exceed available evidence.
neptune.capricorn: Ideals enter your career, responsibilities, and long-term planning. The real task is to turn a vision into workable steps without chasing external standards alone.
neptune.aquarius: Imagination attaches to collective futures, networks and ideals of social progress.
neptune.pisces: Imagination is highly receptive, compassionate and difficult to separate from surrounding feeling.

pluto.aries: Transformation works through will, conflict and the recovery of direct personal agency.
pluto.taurus: Transformation works through resources, attachment and deep revisions to what feels secure.
pluto.gemini: Transformation works through language, information and the power to redefine a narrative.
pluto.cancer: Transformation works through family patterns, emotional inheritance and the meaning of home.
pluto.leo: Transformation works through visibility, pride and the demand for more authentic self-expression.
pluto.virgo: Transformation works through habits, work systems and the elimination of ineffective routines.
pluto.libra: Transformation works through relationship power, agreement and the balance between self and other.
pluto.scorpio: Transformation is concentrated, psychologically intense and oriented toward total renewal.
pluto.sagittarius: Transformation works through belief, ideology and the exposure of hidden assumptions.
pluto.capricorn: Transformation works through institutions, authority and the restructuring of long-standing systems.
pluto.aquarius: Deep change unfolds through communities, technology, networks, and collective rules. You are especially sensitive to how systems distribute power and freedom.
pluto.pisces: Transformation works through surrender, compassion and the dissolution of obsolete emotional boundaries.

trueNode.aries: Long-term growth develops through initiative, self-trust and the willingness to act without waiting for consensus.
trueNode.taurus: Long-term growth develops through steadiness, clear values and the patient creation of material and emotional security.
trueNode.gemini: Long-term growth develops through curiosity, listening, flexible thinking and active exchange with the immediate environment.
trueNode.cancer: Long-term growth develops through emotional honesty, care, belonging and the courage to build a secure inner base.
trueNode.leo: Long-term growth develops through creative visibility, confidence and the willingness to make a personal contribution.
trueNode.virgo: Long-term growth develops through discernment, practical skill, service and routines that make life more workable.
trueNode.libra: Long-term growth develops through cooperation, fairness and mutuality without losing personal direction.
trueNode.scorpio: Long-term growth develops through depth, trust, shared consequence and the willingness to change what can no longer remain superficial.
trueNode.sagittarius: Long-term growth develops through exploration, conviction and contact with a wider intellectual or cultural horizon.
trueNode.capricorn: Long-term growth develops through responsibility, authority and the patient construction of durable goals.
trueNode.aquarius: Long-term growth develops through community, future-oriented ideas and the courage to contribute without surrendering individuality.
trueNode.pisces: Long-term growth develops through compassion, intuition, imagination and greater trust in meanings that cannot be fully controlled.

sun.moon.supportive: It is relatively easy for you to align what you want to do with how you truly feel. Once a decision is made, your inner responses are more likely to support it.
sun.moon.challenging: You may know exactly where you want to go while your emotions require a different pace. Important choices often ask you to care for both the goal and your sense of security.
sun.moon.neutral: Personal will and emotional response sit close together. It is hard for you to remove feeling entirely from a decision, and your mood often enters the way you express yourself.

sun.mercury.supportive: You usually know what you want to say and can explain your position clearly. Thinking and self-expression help move each other forward.
sun.mercury.challenging: You may rush to prove a point or hear disagreement as a rejection of who you are. Slowing down your explanation can reduce unnecessary defensiveness.
sun.mercury.neutral: Your way of thinking is closely tied to your identity. Your opinions carry a distinct personal stamp and strongly shape how others understand you.

sun.venus.supportive: You can express affection, taste, and personal charm naturally, while keeping relationship choices aligned with what you genuinely value.
sun.venus.challenging: You may waver between standing by yourself, seeking recognition, and protecting other people's feelings. Excessive pleasing can push your real needs out of view.
sun.venus.neutral: Relationships, aesthetics, and value judgments are central to how you define yourself. What you love and whom you choose both become forms of self-expression.

sun.mars.supportive: You can turn intention into action with relative ease. When a goal is clear, courage, initiative, and execution gather quickly.
sun.mars.challenging: Pride and the impulse to act can ignite each other. When challenged, you may react too quickly and turn a disagreement into a contest.
sun.mars.neutral: Personal will and drive are closely linked. You tend to prove yourself through action and find it difficult to suppress what you truly want to do for long.

sun.jupiter.supportive: You readily believe in your capacity to grow and are willing to take on a larger role. Optimism and generosity can open doors for you.
sun.jupiter.challenging: You may overestimate your ability, time, or resources and only discover the burden after taking on too much. Confidence needs to be measured against real conditions.
sun.jupiter.neutral: Identity and the desire to grow are closely connected. You keep searching for a larger stage, deeper meaning, or wider possibilities for your life.

sun.saturn.supportive: You can turn high standards into dependable ability. Responsibility, endurance, and long-term practice gradually build solid confidence.
sun.saturn.challenging: You may be too hard on yourself, seeing the shortfall before allowing yourself to act. Authority, evaluation, and fear of failure can become heavy pressure.
sun.saturn.neutral: Responsibility and self-definition are closely linked. You often confirm your value by taking on duties, keeping promises, and standing the test of time.

sun.uranus.supportive: You have a strong independent streak and are willing to update an outdated identity. Original ideas can help you find a way of living that suits you better.
sun.uranus.challenging: You may swing suddenly between maintaining stability and escaping restriction. Ending something too quickly to prove independence can leave important issues unresolved.
sun.uranus.neutral: Individuality is central to your identity. You cannot play a role that contradicts your real thinking for long and will keep adjusting how you present yourself.

sun.neptune.supportive: Imagination, empathy, and creativity can enrich your self-expression. Art, ideals, or subtle feeling often help you find direction.
sun.neptune.challenging: You may mix expectations, projections, or other people's needs into your self-assessment, leaving your goals unclear. Confirming facts and boundaries becomes especially important.
sun.neptune.neutral: Your identity carries strong sensitivity and idealism. Atmosphere, symbols, and invisible meanings can affect you deeply.

sun.pluto.supportive: You can face difficulty and rebuild yourself. The more real the pressure, the more it may call forth focus, resilience, and profound change.
sun.pluto.challenging: Control, authority, and the need to prove yourself can become excessive. You may treat compromise as a loss of power and fall into an all-or-nothing struggle.
sun.pluto.neutral: Your self-expression has considerable impact. Important experiences often force you to redefine power, identity, and what you truly cannot compromise.

moon.mercury.supportive: You can usually understand what you feel and put it into words. Communication helps restore order and security.
moon.mercury.challenging: Emotion and thought can crowd each other out. You may overanalyze while also being quickly affected by tone or small details.
moon.mercury.neutral: Feeling enters language and judgment directly. Your speech often carries a clear emotional tone, and you rely on communication to organize your inner life.

moon.venus.supportive: You can build intimacy through tenderness, care, and steady responses. Comfort and security in a relationship tend to reinforce each other.
moon.venus.challenging: You may suppress genuine emotion to preserve harmony or mistake being liked for being understood. Relationships require more honest expression of need.
moon.venus.neutral: Affection and security are closely connected. Familiarity, being cared for, and the emotional climate of a relationship deeply affect your mood.

moon.mars.supportive: You can turn feeling into action quickly and have a strong protective instinct. Your response is usually direct when important people or matters are involved.
moon.mars.challenging: Once emotion is triggered, action follows immediately. Irritability, defensiveness, or argument may appear before you understand what you truly need.
moon.mars.neutral: Mood and drive are closely linked. When you feel secure, motivation is strong; when threatened, you may enter a defensive state at once.

moon.jupiter.supportive: You have strong emotional resilience and can recover hope through support, meaning, and a wider perspective.
moon.jupiter.challenging: Emotion is easily magnified. You may promise too much when happy or enlarge a problem when upset, so a steadier measure is needed.
moon.jupiter.neutral: Security is closely tied to belief, growth, and room to live. Your emotions open more easily when you can still sense possibility ahead.

moon.saturn.supportive: You can stay composed under pressure and are willing to care for others through practical action. Long-term reliability matters more than brief reassurance.
moon.saturn.challenging: You may handle responsibility first and your own feelings later. Isolation, suppression, or reluctance to ask for help can make the emotional burden increasingly heavy.
moon.saturn.neutral: Security is closely tied to responsibility, order, and dependability. You do not expose vulnerability easily and care deeply about whether promises are kept.

moon.uranus.supportive: You respond sharply to change and can adapt quickly to a new emotional environment. Giving a relationship enough space helps keep it alive.
moon.uranus.challenging: A familiar rhythm may be disrupted suddenly, and your mood can change just as fast. When resistance to constraint becomes extreme, stable relationships may be shaken.
moon.uranus.neutral: The need for security and the need for freedom coexist. You want closeness, but you also need room for an independent response and a change of pace.

moon.neptune.supportive: You have strong empathy and intuition, can sense subtle emotion, and often find comfort through imagination, art, or quiet surroundings.
moon.neptune.challenging: You may absorb too much of other people's emotion or mistake hope for reality. Clear boundaries and sufficient rest reduce confusion.
moon.neptune.neutral: Your inner experience is highly sensitive and often expressed through images, intuition, and symbols. You need time to distinguish which feelings are truly your own.

moon.pluto.supportive: You can understand emotion deeply and carry out genuine repair. Once trust is established, loyalty and emotional resilience are exceptionally strong.
moon.pluto.challenging: Attachment, control, and fear of loss can become magnified. Intense reactions often point to a deeper security issue that needs honest attention.
moon.pluto.neutral: Emotional experience carries profound psychological force. Relationships, family, and trust issues often bring long-lasting and fundamental change.

mercury.venus.supportive: You can express your views with tact and are skilled at finding language that both sides of a relationship can accept.
mercury.venus.challenging: You may soften a message until it is no longer precise or hesitate between an honest opinion and preserving harmony.
mercury.venus.neutral: Language, aesthetics, and value judgments are closely connected. How you speak directly affects whether others want to approach and cooperate with you.

mercury.mars.supportive: Speed of thought and power of action can work together. You are good at making quick decisions and solving problems directly.
mercury.mars.challenging: You may speak too quickly or sharply or draw a conclusion before the information is complete. Argument can easily replace real understanding.
mercury.mars.neutral: Thought and action sit close together. Your language usually has momentum and may also carry a clear note of competition or challenge.

mercury.jupiter.supportive: You are good at placing scattered information into a larger framework and can broaden your perspective through learning, teaching, and exchange.
mercury.jupiter.challenging: You may generalize too early, overlook detail, or struggle to follow through because there are too many ideas. A wider perspective still needs factual support.
mercury.jupiter.neutral: Your thinking keeps reaching toward larger meaning. Knowing what happened is not enough; you also want to understand why it matters.

mercury.saturn.supportive: You can organize complex information patiently and are well suited to long-term study, rigorous writing, and work that requires precise judgment.
mercury.saturn.challenging: You may fear saying the wrong thing, check repeatedly, or turn communication into pressure. Silence can come from care, but it can also come from self-restraint.
mercury.saturn.neutral: Language and a sense of responsibility are closely connected. You speak carefully and seriously consider the consequences information may create.

mercury.uranus.supportive: You quickly notice connections others miss and are willing to propose new methods. Original thinking and technical understanding are often strengths.
mercury.uranus.challenging: Ideas and expression may jump too quickly for others to follow. Sudden, forceful opinions can also interrupt communication.
mercury.uranus.neutral: Your mind needs freedom and freshness. You cannot accept rigid answers for long and keep testing different explanations and systems.

mercury.neptune.supportive: You understand symbols, tone, and what is implied, and can turn intuition, images, and feeling into compelling expression.
mercury.neptune.challenging: Information, imagination, and expectation can blur together. Important decisions require active verification of facts and concrete conditions.
mercury.neptune.neutral: Your understanding is associative and intuitive. You often sense that something is true before completing the logic that explains it.

mercury.pluto.supportive: You are skilled at deep research, recognizing motives, and asking complex questions until they reach the essential point. Language can produce genuine insight.
mercury.pluto.challenging: Suspicion and the need for control can make communication tense. Repeated questioning, compulsive proving, or verbal pressure can damage trust.
mercury.pluto.neutral: Your thinking has strong penetrating power. You dislike remaining on the surface and can influence situations and other people's judgments through language.

venus.mars.supportive: Affection and the direction of action are relatively easy to align. You can show interest naturally, and relationships often develop clear attraction and interaction.
venus.mars.challenging: What you like and what you pursue may not move at the same pace. Timing, style of pursuit, and expectations of intimacy can create obvious friction.
venus.mars.neutral: Affection and desire are closely linked. Relationships are rarely entirely quiet; attraction, competition, and initiative often appear together.

venus.jupiter.supportive: You readily build relationships through generosity, goodwill, and openness and are willing to share resources, opportunities, and enjoyment.
venus.jupiter.challenging: You may overspend or overpromise for pleasure or to preserve goodwill. Optimism in relationships needs realistic limits.
venus.jupiter.neutral: Value judgments and the desire to grow are closely connected. Relationships, money, and aesthetic choices often change as your view of life expands.

venus.saturn.supportive: You value reliability, longevity, and affection that can be demonstrated. Patient investment gradually makes a relationship secure.
venus.saturn.challenging: Intimacy may involve distance, delay, or fear of rejection. You need to learn how to protect yourself without becoming emotionally unreachable.
venus.saturn.neutral: Love and responsibility are closely connected. It is difficult for you to treat a relationship as a light experience; commitment and long-term consequences matter.

venus.uranus.supportive: You can accept unconventional forms of relationship and value honesty and personal space. Freshness gives a connection vitality.
venus.uranus.challenging: Attraction may arrive suddenly, and the rhythm can shift between closeness and distance. A strong need for freedom tests stability.
venus.uranus.neutral: Intimacy and independence are always present together. You need connection, but you also need room for change and redefinition.

venus.neptune.supportive: You are highly sensitive to tenderness, romance, and subtle feeling, with strong artistic taste and empathy.
venus.neptune.challenging: You may see the ideal person and overlook real conditions. Ambiguity, rescue fantasies, and unclear boundaries require particular care.
venus.neptune.neutral: Affection often carries imaginative and symbolic meaning. You are drawn to atmosphere, temperament, and emotional connections that are difficult to explain.

venus.pluto.supportive: You can build deep, loyal relationships that transform both people. Genuine intimacy asks each person to face themselves more honestly.
venus.pluto.challenging: Love and control can become entangled. Jealousy, possessiveness, unequal power, or fear of loss can place a relationship under intense strain.
venus.pluto.neutral: A relationship is rarely only surface companionship. Attraction, trust, and value choices often have far-reaching psychological effects.

mars.jupiter.supportive: Drive and confidence can reinforce each other. You dare to take on larger tasks and often find opportunity inside a challenge.
mars.jupiter.challenging: You may mistake speed for ability and risk for certainty. Overcommitment, premature expansion, or ignored danger can drain your resources.
mars.jupiter.neutral: Action tends to enlarge the situation. When you do something, you naturally want to take it further and make it bigger.

mars.saturn.supportive: You can control your force, pace your effort, and continue under difficult conditions. Endurance is often more dependable than a burst of energy.
mars.saturn.challenging: Action may meet resistance, delay, or strict limits. Trying to break through too quickly increases frustration; changing the method and timing works better.
mars.saturn.neutral: Drive and limitation are closely connected. Long training teaches you when to persist and when to reduce force.

mars.uranus.supportive: You are willing to test a new method quickly and can act decisively in changing conditions. Independent judgment often creates a breakthrough.
mars.uranus.challenging: Impulse and sudden change can appear together. Acting too quickly, breaking off abruptly, or reacting intensely to restriction increases risk.
mars.uranus.neutral: Your way of acting rarely follows convention completely. You need freedom, speed, and change, while also leaving room for unexpected consequences.

mars.neptune.supportive: Inspiration, empathy, and action can work together. You are well suited to creative work, helping roles, or situations that require intuitive judgment.
mars.neptune.challenging: Goals and motives may be unclear, and the environment can drain your energy. Confirming responsibility, boundaries, and practical steps before beginning is important.
mars.neptune.neutral: Your drive is highly sensitive to atmosphere and belief. You commit deeply when something feels meaningful and can lose motivation when direction is vague.

mars.pluto.supportive: You can concentrate force on high-pressure tasks and have the capacity to endure difficulty until a major change is complete.
mars.pluto.challenging: Action can turn into a power struggle or compulsive effort. The more completely you try to control the outcome, the greater the conflict and exhaustion may become.
mars.pluto.neutral: Your drive carries intensity and awareness of consequence. Once you truly commit, you rarely settle for a superficial adjustment.

jupiter.saturn.supportive: You can consider cost and timing while expanding opportunity. Long-term results are most reliable when vision and structure work together.
jupiter.saturn.challenging: You may swing between wanting to expand and fearing a loss of control. Opportunity and limitation need realistic ordering rather than unquestioned loyalty to either side.
jupiter.saturn.neutral: Growth and responsibility continually shape each other. Your progress often comes in clear stages and depends greatly on whether the timing is mature.

jupiter.uranus.supportive: Innovation, cross-disciplinary work, and bold experiments can open opportunities for you. Changing an old method often creates greater room for development.
jupiter.uranus.challenging: The expectation of a breakthrough may lead you to take excessive risks or change direction suddenly before an opportunity is ready.
jupiter.uranus.neutral: Growth often arrives in unconventional ways. New ideas, technologies, or communities can rapidly alter your path of development.

jupiter.neptune.supportive: Belief, imagination, and empathy can nourish one another. You are easily drawn to larger meaning, creative work, or a vision of helping others.
jupiter.neptune.challenging: Hope may run ahead of evidence. Idealization, weak boundaries, or inflated expectations can remove the realistic basis of judgment.
jupiter.neptune.neutral: You keep searching for meaning beyond everyday life. Faith, imagination, and a vision for life can become major sources of momentum.

jupiter.pluto.supportive: You can concentrate resources, influence, and long-term ambition and are suited to driving change on a larger scale.
jupiter.pluto.challenging: Expansion and control can reinforce each other. An excessive pursuit of results, power, or absolute success may make the methods lose proportion.
jupiter.pluto.neutral: Growth often comes with significant shifts in power and resources. Your choices can affect larger systems and carry deeper consequences.

saturn.uranus.supportive: You can advance reform while preserving a reliable foundation. Effective change is tested and capable of working over the long term.
saturn.uranus.challenging: You may need stability while being unable to tolerate an old restriction any longer. Prolonged deadlock can make change arrive more abruptly.
saturn.uranus.neutral: Tradition and renewal are always present together. Life repeatedly asks you which structures deserve preservation and which need to be rebuilt.

saturn.neptune.supportive: You can give inspiration an orderly form and turn a vague vision into a plan that can be pursued over time.
saturn.neptune.challenging: You may feel disappointed or lost between real responsibilities and ideal expectations. Facts, boundaries, and workable steps must be clear before you can decide what is worth continuing.
saturn.neptune.neutral: Ideals must face a reality check, while reality still needs meaning. You will spend a long time learning how to let both exist together.

saturn.pluto.supportive: You can withstand pressure, rebuild order, and handle a prolonged crisis. The more complex the problem, the more it calls for patience and strategy.
saturn.pluto.challenging: An old structure may no longer be sustainable but still be difficult to release. Control, responsibility, and survival pressure force deep adjustment.
saturn.pluto.neutral: Responsibility and major change are closely connected. You may repeatedly pass through stages that require a complete reorganization of rules and power.

uranus.neptune.supportive: Innovation and imagination can combine, helping you envision new cultural forms, technological uses, or ways of living.
uranus.neptune.challenging: Novel ideas and vague visions can become mixed together. When inspiration is abundant, verify which proposals are actually workable.
uranus.neptune.neutral: You are sensitive to collective ideals and shifts in the times and are easily drawn to new ideas, art, and images of the future.

uranus.pluto.supportive: You have the power to advance deep reform and can find a completely different solution when an old system stops working.
uranus.pluto.challenging: Change may be forceful and irreversible. When small adjustments cannot solve the problem, conflict and rupture increase markedly.
uranus.pluto.neutral: You are sensitive to systemic change and the redistribution of power. Important turning points rarely remain superficial.

neptune.pluto.supportive: You can sense changes in deep psychology and collective atmosphere and may renew yourself through creativity, healing, or spiritual exploration.
neptune.pluto.challenging: Fear, projection, and influences that are hard to verify may be magnified. Complex feelings require time and a basis in reality.
neptune.pluto.neutral: Imagination, the unconscious, and deep change remain intertwined over long periods. This pattern reflects the shared background of a generation more than an individual trait.

sun.trueNode.supportive: Personal choices tend to align with your long-term direction of growth. The more honestly you express yourself, the more easily you move toward the next stage.
sun.trueNode.challenging: A familiar self-image may block new development. You need to release choices made only to preserve an image.
sun.trueNode.neutral: Identity choices often become turning points in life. Important decisions repeatedly remind you of the person you are becoming.

moon.trueNode.supportive: Emotional needs and long-term direction are relatively easy to coordinate. Taking your true feelings seriously helps you make better choices.
moon.trueNode.challenging: The need for security may keep you inside familiar patterns. Growth asks you to try new emotional responses and new ways of belonging.
moon.trueNode.neutral: Family, attachment, and emotional habits directly affect your direction of development. Important turning points often begin with a change in inner needs.

mercury.trueNode.supportive: Learning, communication, and key decisions can advance long-term growth. Saying what you truly think can open a new path.
mercury.trueNode.challenging: Old viewpoints or communication habits may limit development. You need updated information and a fresh look at long-term choices.
mercury.trueNode.neutral: Important conversations and learning experiences often carry directional meaning. Certain information can alter the road you take afterward.

venus.trueNode.supportive: Relationships and value choices are relatively likely to support long-term development. The right connection helps you understand yourself more clearly.
venus.trueNode.challenging: Familiar relationship patterns or standards of value may no longer suit the next stage. Growth asks for more honest choices.
venus.trueNode.neutral: Relationships, money, and value judgments often become turning points in development. What you choose to value also shapes your future direction.

mars.trueNode.supportive: Action and courage can move your long-term direction forward. A willingness to take initiative makes opportunities more concrete.
mars.trueNode.challenging: Impulse, competition, or excessive force may pull you away from the real goal. Confirm the direction before acting.
mars.trueNode.neutral: Key actions often carry turning-point significance. How you use your strength directly affects the next stage of development.

jupiter.trueNode.supportive: Learning, opportunity, and a wider perspective can support long-term growth. Measured expansion opens new roads.
jupiter.trueNode.challenging: Excessive optimism or goals that are too large may distract you from the growth task that actually needs to be completed.
jupiter.trueNode.neutral: Education, travel, belief, and opportunity often trigger changes of direction. Your worldview keeps moving your life forward.

saturn.trueNode.supportive: Responsibility, patience, and long-term building can help you move toward a more mature direction.
saturn.trueNode.challenging: Fear of failure, limitation, or responsibility may slow development. Growth asks you to take on the necessary realities.
saturn.trueNode.neutral: Long-term responsibility often carries directional meaning. Important phases ask you to define what must be completed seriously.

uranus.trueNode.supportive: Independent choices and innovative experiments can open a new path of development. A decision outside convention may be pivotal.
uranus.trueNode.challenging: A sudden change made only to escape restriction can destabilize your direction. Freedom still needs to connect with long-term aims.
uranus.trueNode.neutral: Sudden change, technology, and new communities often become life turning points. Your path may repeatedly diverge from traditional expectations.

neptune.trueNode.supportive: Intuition, creativity, and empathy can guide long-term growth. Subtle feeling sometimes points toward what is genuinely worth approaching.
neptune.trueNode.challenging: Ideals, projection, or unclear expectations may interfere with directional judgment. Important choices need a basis in reality.
neptune.trueNode.neutral: Vision, faith, and emotional perception often carry directional meaning. You need to distinguish repeatedly between a genuine calling and a fantasy.

pluto.trueNode.supportive: Facing a deep issue and making the necessary change can move you into a more empowered stage of development.
pluto.trueNode.challenging: Control, fear, or attachment to an old identity may block transformation. Growth often requires a genuine release.
pluto.trueNode.neutral: Major shifts of power and psychological turning points often carry directional significance. Pivotal phases are rarely minor adjustments.
