disruption.headline: Redesigning everyday systems
disruption.body: This period exposes routines that are too rigid, inefficient or disconnected from current needs.

boundaries.headline: Clarifying your role within the group
boundaries.body: This period asks for more realistic expectations around friendship, community and shared responsibility.

expansion.headline: Widening the field of connection
expansion.body: This period supports community, collaboration and plans that become more possible through other people.

building.headline: Turning effort into something durable
building.body: This period supports patient construction, clearer standards and progress that can survive beyond immediate enthusiasm.

release.headline: Releasing a structure that has completed its purpose
release.body: This period makes it harder to preserve an old pattern simply because it once provided control or certainty.

deepening.headline: Developing a more honest basis for trust
deepening.body: This period brings shared resources, intimacy and emotional risk into clearer focus.

fog.headline: Distinguishing intuition from assumption
fog.body: This period increases sensitivity and imagination, but it also requires clearer evidence, boundaries and recovery time.

reassessment.headline: Clarifying what still deserves commitment
reassessment.body: This period reveals where preferences, loyalties or material choices no longer match current priorities.

durable-structure.headline: Pressure is asking for a stronger foundation
durable-structure.body: The dominant cycles emphasize responsibility, limits and necessary correction. Progress may feel slower, yet the work now can remove weak arrangements and establish something more dependable.
durable-structure.guidance: Strengthen the part that must remain reliable under pressure.

expansion-structure.headline: Expansion works best inside clearer boundaries
expansion-structure.body: Several active cycles point in different directions. Growth is available, but it becomes sustainable only when commitments, timing and emotional expectations are made more explicit.
expansion-structure.guidance: Choose the opportunities that can survive realistic limits.

focused-expansion.headline: Growth becomes useful when it has a clear focus
focused-expansion.body: The strongest cycles are opening possibilities and restoring confidence. A defined priority will help opportunity turn into progress instead of scattering attention.
focused-expansion.guidance: Select the opening that best supports your longer direction.

steady-realignment.headline: The current period favors steady realignment
steady-realignment.body: No single cycle is forcing a dramatic outcome. Smaller adjustments in priorities, routines and expectations can gradually bring the situation into better alignment.
steady-realignment.guidance: Make one clear adjustment, then observe what changes before moving further.

balanced.headline: Close, with room to be yourselves
balanced.body: This connection blends ease, interest, and difference in a fairly even way. You can find common ground without needing to react, feel, or want the same things all the time.

supportive.headline: You tend to bring out the best in each other
supportive.body: There is a naturally supportive tone between you. Encouragement may come more easily, and small misunderstandings are less likely to define the whole relationship.

growth-through-friction.headline: This connection can push both of you to grow
growth-through-friction.body: There is real potential here, along with points that can rub. The relationship becomes more rewarding when differences are explored with curiosity instead of turned into a contest over who is right.

intense.headline: A strong pull, with strong reactions
intense.body: This connection can feel hard to ignore. Attraction, emotion, or tension may rise quickly, making the bond vivid and memorable. A little space can help keep intensity from turning into pressure.

mental-activation.headline: {{otherName}} gets your mind moving
mental-activation.body: Around {{otherName}}, you may think faster, ask more questions, or notice ideas you would normally pass over. Conversation and mental stimulation can become a noticeable part of how you experience this bond.

emotional-activation.headline: {{otherName}} reaches your emotional side
emotional-activation.body: Your feelings may become more immediate around {{otherName}}. You can feel more open, sensitive, protective, or easily affected, depending on what is happening between you.

relational-activation.headline: {{otherName}} makes closeness more noticeable
relational-activation.body: With {{otherName}}, you may become more aware of attraction, affection, reciprocity, and what you want from a relationship. The bond can bring your preferences in love and connection into sharper focus.

practical-activation.headline: {{otherName}} brings real-life questions into focus
practical-activation.body: Your experience of {{otherName}} may quickly turn toward everyday choices, responsibilities, timing, or what actually works in practice. You are likely to notice how well the connection fits into real life.

mixed-activation.headline: {{otherName}} brings out several sides of you
mixed-activation.body: Your response to {{otherName}} is layered. Thoughts, feelings, attraction, and practical concerns may all become active at once, so your experience of the relationship can shift depending on the moment.

flow.headline: Emotional understanding comes more naturally
flow.body: It may be easier to read each other's moods and respond in ways that feel reassuring. Even without perfect agreement, there is usually a path back to emotional connection.
Comfort and reassurance can build quickly when one of you reaches out.

difference.body: Different emotional habits still matter, but they are less likely to feel threatening.

friction.headline: Feelings can get tangled quickly
friction.body: You may care deeply and still miss each other's emotional timing. Reactions can escalate when one person wants closeness while the other needs a different kind of response.

flow.body: Connection improves when feelings are named before assumptions take over.

difference.body: Your emotional rhythms may clash, especially under stress or when reassurance is expected immediately.

mixed.headline: Warmth and sensitivity come together
mixed.body: There are moments when emotional closeness feels easy, and others when you seem to speak different emotional languages. The bond can feel caring and complicated at the same time.

flow.body: Some situations bring out genuine tenderness and a strong sense of being understood.

difference.body: Other situations expose mismatched needs, timing, or ways of asking for support.

quiet.headline: The emotional tone is more understated
quiet.body: This connection may not stir strong emotional reactions on its own. Feelings can still deepen, but they may need more time, shared experience, or deliberate openness to become obvious.

flow.body: Emotional ease may show up in simple consistency rather than dramatic reassurance.

difference.body: If something feels missing, it may help to ask directly instead of waiting for the bond to signal it for you.

flow.headline: Talking things through comes more easily
flow.body: You are more likely to understand what the other person means, even when your wording is different. Conversation can help the relationship move forward instead of adding confusion.

friction.headline: Small wording differences can become big misunderstandings
friction.body: You may process information differently or react quickly to tone, timing, and phrasing. The same conversation can leave each of you thinking something very different happened.

mixed.headline: Some conversations click, others need work
mixed.body: You can have lively, productive exchanges and still run into recurring misunderstandings. The quality of communication may depend heavily on the topic and emotional temperature.

quiet.headline: Communication may need a little more intention
quiet.body: The connection does not automatically create a strong mental rhythm. Conversation may stay practical or surface-level unless one of you makes room for curiosity and deeper exchange.

flow.headline: Attraction tends to feel easy and mutual
flow.body: There is a natural spark here, with less effort needed to create warmth, interest, or physical closeness. The attraction can feel inviting rather than demanding.

friction.headline: The spark is real, but it can run hot
friction.body: Attraction and irritation may sit close together. Desire can be strong, yet differences in pace, boundaries, or expression may create tension if neither person slows down enough to read the other.

mixed.headline: Attraction comes in waves
mixed.body: There are clear points of chemistry, but they may not all pull in the same direction. Some moments feel magnetic, while others bring hesitation, mismatch, or a need for more space.

quiet.headline: Chemistry may build slowly
quiet.body: This connection may not begin with an obvious rush of attraction. Interest can still grow through trust, familiarity, and shared experience rather than instant intensity.

flow.headline: There is room to build something lasting
flow.body: The relationship has a workable balance between steadiness and forward movement. It may feel easier to make plans, support each other's growth, and keep showing up over time.

stability.body: Consistency is easier to create when expectations are clear and both people follow through.

growth.body: The bond can support change without making every new direction feel like a threat.

friction.headline: Long-term plans may expose the pressure points
friction.body: The closer you get to shared responsibilities or future decisions, the more differences can surface. Commitment may require explicit agreements rather than assumptions about what each person should naturally provide.

stability.body: Reliability improves when duties, boundaries, and timing are discussed in concrete terms.

growth.body: Growth may feel uneven if one person's need for expansion keeps colliding with the other's need for certainty.

mixed.headline: There is potential, but the pace may not stay even
mixed.body: Some parts of the relationship support consistency while others keep asking for adjustment. Long-term potential depends less on perfect harmony and more on how you handle changing needs.

stability.body: Certain routines and promises can become strong anchors for the relationship.

growth.body: New opportunities can be positive, though they may require renegotiating plans along the way.

quiet.headline: Commitment is shaped more by choices than momentum
quiet.body: The relationship may not create a strong built-in push toward permanence. If you want something lasting, consistency, shared priorities, and deliberate decisions will matter more than simply waiting for the bond to define itself.

stability.body: Reliability grows through repeated actions rather than a strong automatic sense of obligation.

growth.body: Future direction becomes clearer when you actively decide what you want to build together.

mixed.headline: You affect different parts of each other's lives
mixed.body: This connection is likely to feel stronger in some life areas than others. The house overlays show where each person tends to draw attention, create activity, or make the relationship feel especially personal.

flow.headline: The strongest links work mostly in your favor
flow.body: The most influential contacts between your charts tend to support connection, understanding, or momentum. They do not erase every difference, but they give the relationship useful places to return to.

friction.headline: The strongest links ask for more adjustment
friction.body: The most influential contacts between your charts are likely to create noticeable tension, contrast, or pressure. These patterns can be important, but they work best when neither person treats them as a reason to force change.

mixed.headline: Your strongest links tell more than one story
mixed.body: Some major contacts make the relationship easier while others make it more demanding. The overall pattern is layered, so individual aspects matter more than a single good-or-bad verdict.

quiet.headline: No single aspect dominates the connection
quiet.body: There may be fewer standout contacts shaping the whole relationship. That can make the bond feel less scripted, with more of its character emerging from everyday choices and the combination of smaller patterns.

policy.description: The classical preset relies primarily on the seven traditional planets, traditional rulerships, essential dignity, sect, house strength, reception, and conditions for aspect perfection.
policy.outerPlanets: Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto may be displayed as additional technical points, but they may not serve as chart rulers, house rulers, subjects of dignity or sect, or the sole basis of a primary theme.
policy.trueNode: trueNode may participate in aspect and house analysis as an additional point of development, but it has no rulership and does not participate in dignity or sect.

chartRulerCopy.sun: When the Sun is the chart ruler, life direction is closely tied to personal will, reputation, and the ability to carry core responsibility. In good condition, the Sun gives clearer purpose; when afflicted, confidence, authority, or visibility may become sources of pressure.
chartRulerCopy.moon: When the Moon is the chart ruler, daily rhythm, physical condition, family environment, and emotional security directly affect overall development. In good condition, the Moon supports adaptability; when afflicted, change and unease more easily disturb judgment.
chartRulerCopy.mercury: When Mercury is the chart ruler, learning, communication, trade, and information judgment are central tools of life. In good condition, Mercury gives flexible, clear thinking; when afflicted, repetition, misunderstanding, or faulty decisions become more likely.
chartRulerCopy.venus: When Venus is the chart ruler, relationships, cooperation, value judgments, and quality of life strongly influence life choices. In good condition, Venus brings support and coordination; when afflicted, relationships and the distribution of resources require clearer boundaries.
chartRulerCopy.mars: When Mars is the chart ruler, action, competition, conflict management, and self-protection become major life themes. In good condition, Mars gives courage and execution; when afflicted, haste, depletion, or confrontation need more careful management.
chartRulerCopy.jupiter: When Jupiter is the chart ruler, growth, belief, education, opportunity, and social support help life unfold. In good condition, Jupiter provides space and assistance; when afflicted, excessive optimism or judgment that is too broad may carry a cost.
chartRulerCopy.saturn: When Saturn is the chart ruler, responsibility, limitation, time, and long-term construction shape the life path. In good condition, Saturn gives reliable endurance and organization; when afflicted, delay, pressure, or isolation become more pronounced.

bodyTheme.sun: Will, authority, reputation, and core aims
bodyTheme.moon: The body, daily rhythm, family, and change

domicile.headline: This planet can act according to its own principles
domicile.body: It has relatively stable resources and modes of expression, making it easier to carry out the matters it signifies consistently.

exaltation.headline: This planet is notably elevated
exaltation.body: Its abilities are more visible and have greater room to operate, though expectations still need to remain proportionate.

triplicity.headline: This planet receives support from its environment
triplicity.body: Under the relevant conditions, it can more readily find assistance, compatible resources, and sustainable ways to function.

term.headline: This planet has limited but practical room to act
term.body: It may not be strong in every respect, but it can handle matters effectively within a defined range.

face.headline: This planet retains a basic capacity for expression
face.body: The support is modest, but the planet can preserve a degree of function and dignity; other conditions are needed for fuller expression.

detriment.headline: This planet must handle matters through unfamiliar means
detriment.body: The relevant ability is not absent, but it is more easily constrained by the environment and needs clearer strategy and external support.

fall.headline: This planet has difficulty functioning steadily
fall.body: The related matters are more prone to imbalance, underestimation, or overcompensation. Reduce depletion and establish a realistic point of support.

peregrine.headline: This planet lacks a clear foothold
peregrine.body: Its actual performance depends more heavily on house placement, aspects, reception, the chart ruler, and other conditions.

sectCopy.dayChart: This is a day chart, determined primarily by the Sun being above the horizon. Jupiter tends to operate more constructively, while Mars requires more careful management.
sectCopy.nightChart: This is a night chart, determined primarily by the Sun being below the horizon. Venus tends to operate more harmoniously, while Saturn requires more careful management.
sectCopy.inSect: This planet agrees with the chart's sect and usually operates in a more manageable and expected manner.
sectCopy.outOfSect: This planet is contrary to the chart's sect, so its pressure is more likely to become excessive, imbalanced, or difficult to control.
sectCopy.sectBenefic: As the more helpful benefic in this chart, it is more likely to provide support, mitigation, and usable opportunities.
sectCopy.contraryBenefic: It remains helpful, but its support may be less direct or require cooperation from other conditions.
sectCopy.sectMalefic: The difficulties it brings are usually more manageable and more capable of being transformed through discipline, boundaries, and experience.
sectCopy.contraryMalefic: It is more likely to become a principal source of pressure in the chart, so its house, dignity, aspects, and reception should be examined first.

accidentalConditionCopy.angular: In an angular house, this planet has greater ability to bring its effects into concrete reality, and the matters it signifies are usually more visible.
accidentalConditionCopy.succedent: In a succedent house, this planet has a degree of staying power, and results often emerge gradually through accumulation and time.
accidentalConditionCopy.cadent: In a cadent house, this planet has more difficulty producing direct results, and its matters depend more on preparation, assistance, or indirect routes.
accidentalConditionCopy.direct: Direct motion usually indicates that matters can proceed in a relatively natural direction.
accidentalConditionCopy.retrograde: Retrograde motion indicates tendencies toward return, revision, delay, or progress outside the usual order.
accidentalConditionCopy.swift: When moving swiftly, a planet is more likely to give momentum to its matters.
accidentalConditionCopy.slow: When moving slowly, matters may be delayed, weakened, or require more time to mature.
accidentalConditionCopy.cazimi: When extremely close to the Sun, this planet receives a special strengthening, and its matters may appear in a concentrated and unmistakable form.
accidentalConditionCopy.combust: When too close to the Sun, this planet has difficulty acting independently and may be obscured by authority, a central aim, or an external focus.
accidentalConditionCopy.underBeams: When under the Sun's beams, this planet cannot act openly; its matters may remain hidden or lack visibility for a time.

receptionCopy.mutual: Mutual reception indicates that, even when difficulties exist, both sides have greater willingness or resources to help each other complete the matter.
receptionCopy.oneWay: One-way reception indicates that one side is more willing to provide support; investment and control in the relationship are not fully equal.
receptionCopy.none: Without reception, the aspect has less capacity for mitigation and must rely on dignity, house placement, or other connections for support.
receptionCopy.prohibition: Prohibition before an aspect perfects indicates that another event, person, or condition may interrupt the original plan.
receptionCopy.collection: Collection of light indicates that two separate conditions may be brought together again through a third party, shared goal, or intermediate mechanism.
receptionCopy.translation: Translation of light indicates that a third party or intervening event may connect two parties that were originally separate.

strong.headline: The chart ruler has favorable conditions for action
strong.body: The main course of life can more readily find stable resources and a clear path. Its real strength comes from the chart ruler's house, dignity, sect condition, and applying aspects.

mixed.headline: The chart ruler has usable resources but also faces practical constraints
mixed.body: Development is not entirely smooth, but it can proceed gradually through good timing, available support, and reduced waste of effort.

strained.headline: The chart ruler needs to use its power with greater care
strained.body: The main course of life is more easily constrained by environment, responsibility, or limited resources. Addressing the chart ruler's weaknesses is more effective than simply increasing effort.

supported.headline: The Moon can maintain a relatively stable rhythm of life
supported.body: The body, emotions, family, and daily arrangements can more readily receive support; recovery usually depends on regularity and a dependable environment.

mixed.headline: The Moon needs to find stability within change
mixed.body: Security is not continuously fixed and requires timely adjustment of daily rhythm according to house, aspects, and motion.

strained.headline: The Moon carries noticeable pressure in everyday life
strained.body: Emotions, the body, and the family environment can readily affect one another. Reducing excessive burdens and establishing repeatable ways to recover become especially important.

supported.headline: Relationships have a sound basis for cooperation
supported.body: When Venus, the ruler of the seventh house, or relevant reception provides support, reciprocity, trust, and sustainable arrangements are easier to establish.

mixed.headline: Relationships depend on clear conditions to remain stable
mixed.body: Attraction and cooperation are present, but commitment, resources, or pace need coordination through specific agreements.

strained.headline: Restrictions within relationships need to be addressed directly
strained.body: When Venus or the ruler of the seventh house is afflicted, distance, misunderstanding, conflicting interests, or pressure from responsibility becomes more pronounced; goodwill alone cannot sustain the relationship.

supported.headline: The career significator has good practical power to advance matters
supported.body: When the ruler of the tenth house, the Sun, or angular planets receive support, duties, reputation, and public results can be built more steadily.

mixed.headline: Career development depends on timing and supporting conditions
mixed.body: Ability and opportunity both exist, but roles, resources, or authority relationships need adjustment before they can stabilize.

strained.headline: Career direction must first address structural resistance
strained.body: When the ruler of the tenth house or a key planet is afflicted, delay, unclear authority, or insufficient resources restrict development; reorganizing the path matters more than accelerating blindly.

sun.moon.supportive: Personal direction and daily rhythm coordinate relatively well, allowing will and everyday needs to support each other.
sun.moon.challenging: Personal direction and daily needs do not easily stay in step; important decisions often require a choice between the goal and stability.
sun.moon.neutral: The Sun and Moon are closely connected, so the central life direction and the state of the body, family, and daily life continually affect each other.

sun.mercury.supportive: Judgment and expression can more readily serve personal aims, supporting clear statements of position and practical progress.
sun.mercury.challenging: Opinions may be influenced by pride or pressure from authority, leading to excessive insistence or errors in judgment.
sun.mercury.neutral: Thought and personal will are closely connected, and speech often directly represents an individual position.

sun.venus.supportive: Self-expression more readily receives support, while relationships, courtesy, and value judgments help advance personal aims.
sun.venus.challenging: Pleasure, approval-seeking, or relationship expectations may weaken a clear direction; personal will must be balanced against external recognition.
sun.venus.neutral: Reputation, relationships, and value choices are closely connected, so social judgment strongly affects personal development.

sun.mars.supportive: Will and action work together well, making it easier to take responsibility quickly when facing competition or difficulty.
sun.mars.challenging: Pride and conflict can ignite each other; urgency to prove oneself or challenge authority may create loss and depletion.
sun.mars.neutral: The Sun and Mars are closely connected, making action, competition, and personal assertion prominent life themes.

sun.jupiter.supportive: Goals are more likely to receive opportunity, support, and wider room for development, benefiting both reputation and confidence.
sun.jupiter.challenging: Confidence or expectation may exceed real conditions; responsibilities and resources need confirmation before expansion.
sun.jupiter.neutral: Personal direction is closely connected to belief, education, and social support.

sun.saturn.supportive: Discipline and responsibility can consolidate personal aims, and long-term effort is more likely to establish status and reliability.
sun.saturn.challenging: Restriction, delay, or pressure from authority tests confidence; excessive harshness may inhibit action.
sun.saturn.neutral: Personal direction is closely connected to responsibility, time, and social position.

sun.trueNode.supportive: Personal direction can more readily connect with later development, and important decisions often open a new road.
sun.trueNode.challenging: Maintaining an established identity may obstruct development, requiring a fresh judgment about what is still worth preserving.
sun.trueNode.neutral: Identity, reputation, and life direction often change together at pivotal moments.

moon.mercury.supportive: Feeling and judgment can work together relatively well, making communication, record-keeping, and observation useful for organizing the situation.
moon.mercury.challenging: Emotion and information can interfere with each other, so misunderstanding, repetition, and problems of tone require more verification.
moon.mercury.neutral: The Moon and Mercury are closely connected, and daily changes and emotional condition directly affect judgment and communication.

moon.venus.supportive: The emotional environment more readily receives comfort and support, while relationships and quality of life help stabilize the situation.
moon.venus.challenging: Ignoring genuine needs to preserve harmony may produce dependence or imbalance within relationships.
moon.venus.neutral: The Moon and Venus are closely connected, so security, relationships, and quality of life continually influence one another.

moon.mars.supportive: Instinctive response and action work together, supporting decisiveness when people or matters require protection.
moon.mars.challenging: Emotion can quickly become argument or defense, and impatience weakens both judgment and relationship stability.
moon.mars.neutral: The Moon and Mars are closely connected, so family, physical condition, and the pace of action readily affect one another.

moon.jupiter.supportive: Emotions and the living environment more readily receive support, strengthening recovery, tolerance, and confidence in the future.
moon.jupiter.challenging: Emotion or expectation may be magnified, and excessive leniency or overcommitment can create later burdens.
moon.jupiter.neutral: The Moon and Jupiter are closely connected, so family, security, and belief jointly influence the development of life.

moon.saturn.supportive: Emotion can be stabilized through order, responsibility, and dependable arrangements, providing considerable endurance.
moon.saturn.challenging: Isolation, suppression, or heavy responsibility may undermine security; avoid carrying everything alone for too long.
moon.saturn.neutral: The Moon and Saturn are closely connected, making family responsibility, bodily rhythm, and long-term stability important themes.

moon.trueNode.supportive: Emotional needs can more readily connect with the direction of development, and changes in family or daily life may create new opportunities.
moon.trueNode.challenging: A familiar environment and old habits may slow development, requiring an adjustment in the source of security.
moon.trueNode.neutral: Changes in family, physical condition, and emotion often signal a turning point in life.

mercury.venus.supportive: Expression is tactful, and trade, negotiation, and relationship communication more readily receive cooperation.
mercury.venus.challenging: Avoiding the main issue to preserve harmony, or allowing preference to influence judgment, may distort information.
mercury.venus.neutral: Mercury and Venus are closely connected, so language, trade, and relationship judgment continually affect one another.

mercury.mars.supportive: Thought and action cooperate quickly, supporting debate, decision-making, and matters that require speed.
mercury.mars.challenging: Speech may become sharp or hasty; argument, mistaken judgment, and impulsive decisions require caution.
mercury.mars.neutral: Mercury and Mars are closely connected, giving communication a pronounced active and competitive quality.

mercury.jupiter.supportive: Learning, judgment, and explanatory ability can more readily expand, supporting teaching, writing, and work with larger frameworks.
mercury.jupiter.challenging: Conclusions may become too broad, allowing detail and fact to be overlooked by optimistic judgment.
mercury.jupiter.neutral: Mercury and Jupiter are closely connected, so knowledge, belief, and the circulation of information jointly shape judgment.

mercury.saturn.supportive: Thinking is rigorous and well suited to long-term study, record management, and matters that require precise responsibility.
mercury.saturn.challenging: Worry, hesitation, or fear of error may compress expression; distinguish carefulness from self-limitation.
mercury.saturn.neutral: Mercury and Saturn are closely connected, so communication, documents, and decisions often carry long-term consequences.

mercury.trueNode.supportive: Learning, documents, trade, or a pivotal conversation can more readily advance later development.
mercury.trueNode.challenging: Old information or mistaken judgment may obstruct the direction ahead, requiring important decisions to be verified again.
mercury.trueNode.neutral: Events involving communication and learning often become points at which the life path changes.

venus.mars.supportive: Attraction and action coordinate relatively well, allowing interest and needs to be expressed naturally in relationships.
venus.mars.challenging: Desire, timing, and reciprocity can come into conflict; avoid turning attraction into a contest.
venus.mars.neutral: Venus and Mars are closely connected, so relationships, desire, and action continually shape one another.

venus.jupiter.supportive: Relationships, resources, and enjoyment more readily receive support, while cooperation and generosity can create opportunity.
venus.jupiter.challenging: Pleasure, spending, or expectation may exceed what can realistically be sustained and therefore requires proportion.
venus.jupiter.neutral: Venus and Jupiter are closely connected, allowing relationships, money, and social opportunities to expand together.

venus.saturn.supportive: Relationships can become stable through responsibility, patience, and explicit commitment.
venus.saturn.challenging: Distance, delay, or limited resources may test a relationship, requiring clearer agreements and long-term investment.
venus.saturn.neutral: Venus and Saturn are closely connected, making intimacy, value, and commitment difficult to separate.

venus.trueNode.supportive: Relationships, cooperation, or value choices can more readily support later development.
venus.trueNode.challenging: Old relationship patterns or the distribution of resources may obstruct the direction ahead, requiring a fresh choice.
venus.trueNode.neutral: Choices involving relationships and money often change the course of life at important stages.

mars.jupiter.supportive: Action is more likely to receive opportunity and support, favoring active efforts to enlarge results.
mars.jupiter.challenging: Risk-taking, haste, or excessive investment may cause loss; scale and pace need control.
mars.jupiter.neutral: Mars and Jupiter are closely connected, so action often brings expansion, competition, and larger consequences.

mars.saturn.supportive: Force can accept discipline and timing, supporting the completion of difficult, long-term tasks.
mars.saturn.challenging: The risk of blocked action, delay, or escalating conflict is high; change the method rather than continuing to push by force.
mars.saturn.neutral: Mars and Saturn are closely connected, making effort, resistance, and endurance recurring themes.

mars.trueNode.supportive: Taking responsibility and acting clearly can more readily move the direction of life forward.
mars.trueNode.challenging: Impulse or misdirected effort may pull you away from the goal, so the real priority needs confirmation first.
mars.trueNode.neutral: Pivotal actions often become points at which the life path changes.

jupiter.saturn.supportive: Expansion and restraint can form a reasonable partnership, supporting long-term construction and steady growth.
jupiter.saturn.challenging: Opportunity and limitation pull against each other; excessive optimism and excessive caution can both slow progress.
jupiter.saturn.neutral: Jupiter and Saturn are closely connected, so development has clear cycles and depends heavily on timing.

jupiter.trueNode.supportive: Education, opportunity, travel, or social support can more readily advance later development.
jupiter.trueNode.challenging: Goals that are too large or judgment that is too broad may divert attention from the task that truly needs completion.
jupiter.trueNode.neutral: Belief, opportunity, and life direction often change together at important moments.

saturn.trueNode.supportive: Accepting responsibility and completing long-term tasks can steadily advance the direction of life.
saturn.trueNode.challenging: Fear, delay, or excessive caution may obstruct development, requiring necessary responsibility to be faced.
saturn.trueNode.neutral: Time, responsibility, and life direction often become concentrated at pivotal stages.

temperament.hotDry: The overall response is quick, active, and direct, with strong drive that also requires management of impatience and depletion.
temperament.hotMoist: The overall response is open, lively, and relationship-oriented, supporting connection and expansion while still requiring boundaries.
temperament.coldDry: The overall response is cautious, restrained, and structure-oriented, with strong endurance that must avoid excessive closure.
temperament.coldMoist: The overall response is sensitive, adaptive, and feeling-oriented, with strong intuition that benefits from a steady rhythm.
temperament.balanced: Neither hot nor cold, dry nor moist fully dominates; actual expression depends more on the chart ruler, the Moon, and angular planets.

planetCondition.strong: This planet receives dignity, house, or sect support at the same time and has relatively strong capacity to advance the matters it signifies.
planetCondition.mixed: This planet has some resources but also faces limitations; the result depends on aspects, reception, and whether the timing cooperates.
planetCondition.strained: This planet lacks stable support or suffers clear affliction; its matters require more careful planning and alternative routes.

quiet.headline: Few strong structures are approaching perfection
quiet.body: When there are no prominent exact aspects or stations, maintain existing matters, observe lunar changes, and wait for conditions to mature.

supportive.headline: Traditional benefics and easy aspects provide support
supportive.body: When Jupiter, Venus, or harmonious aspects with reception predominate, negotiation, progress, and receiving help become easier.

challenging.headline: Mars, Saturn, or difficult aspects increase the cost of action
challenging.body: The present conditions require tighter pacing, clearer responsibility, and priority attention to anything that could prevent completion.

mixed.headline: Support and resistance are present at the same time
mixed.body: Do not judge only by whether an aspect is easy or difficult. Dignity, sect, reception, and whether the aspect will perfect determine the actual outcome.

review.headline: Retrogrades and stations place matters under review
review.body: Old problems, delays, and unfinished matters are more likely to return. Revise the conditions before deciding whether to continue.

progressedSun.aries: The long-term direction enters a more active phase, requiring clearer ownership of decisions and the beginning of a new cycle.
progressedSun.taurus: The long-term direction turns toward stability, resources, and sustained construction; results depend more on patience and a realistic foundation.
progressedSun.gemini: The long-term direction turns toward learning, communication, and multiple connections, bringing a noticeable increase in information and choices.
progressedSun.cancer: The long-term direction turns toward family, belonging, and protective responsibility, making the private foundation more important.
progressedSun.leo: The long-term direction turns toward visibility, leadership, and personal creation, requiring clearer acceptance of a central role.
progressedSun.virgo: The long-term direction turns toward skill, service, and order, making improved methods and concrete responsibility more important.
progressedSun.libra: The long-term direction turns toward relationships, agreements, and fairness and must advance through cooperation and negotiation.
progressedSun.scorpio: The long-term direction turns toward shared resources, trust, and deep adjustment; surface measures are usually insufficient.
progressedSun.sagittarius: The long-term direction turns toward learning, travel, belief, and a wider social perspective.
progressedSun.capricorn: The long-term direction turns toward responsibility, authority, and durable results and must meet the tests of time and structure.
progressedSun.aquarius: The long-term direction turns toward communities, institutions, and collective responsibility; traditional Saturnian themes remain the primary basis of judgment.
progressedSun.pisces: The long-term direction turns toward faith, charity, surrender, and larger meaning; traditional Jupiterian themes remain the primary basis of judgment.

supported.headline: The annual chart ruler has favorable conditions for progress
supported.body: When the solar-return chart ruler receives support through dignity, angularity, or reception, the year's priorities can more readily become concrete progress.

mixed.headline: The year's priorities depend on timing and available resources
mixed.body: The solar-return chart ruler receives both support and constraint; first address the practical conditions shown by its house and aspects.

strained.headline: The annual chart ruler is under clear pressure
strained.body: This year requires tighter risk control, clearer boundaries, and room for delays, revisions, and alternative plans.

bodyRoles.sun: The Sun shows how each person's will, recognition, and leading direction affect the other.
bodyRoles.moon: The Moon shows whether daily rhythms, physical comfort, family needs, and emotional responses are compatible.
bodyRoles.mercury: Mercury shows the capacity for communication, judgment, trade, and resolving misunderstandings.
bodyRoles.venus: Venus shows affection, coordination, value judgments, and the exchange of resources.
bodyRoles.mars: Mars shows desire, competition, conflict, and initiative.
bodyRoles.jupiter: Jupiter shows support, tolerance, growth, and shared belief.
bodyRoles.saturn: Saturn shows responsibility, limitation, endurance, and the cost of the relationship.
bodyRoles.trueNode: The lunar node shows whether the relationship moves both people toward a new direction of development.

mutual-reception.headline: You have a natural way of meeting each other halfway
mutual-reception.body: There is a strong sense of mutual responsiveness in this connection. Even when your styles differ, both of you are more likely to recognize what the other needs and find a workable way to respond.

one-way-reception.headline: The give-and-take may lean one way
one-way-reception.body: There is support in the connection, but it may not feel equally available from both sides. One person may be more ready to adapt, understand, or make room, so reciprocity deserves extra attention.

fortified-support.headline: This bond has something solid to lean on
fortified-support.body: There are dependable strengths in the connection. When circumstances become demanding, one or both of you may be better able to stay grounded and help the relationship regain its footing.

impaired-pressure.headline: Some parts of this connection carry extra strain
impaired-pressure.body: The relationship may have areas that are harder to carry smoothly. Stress, timing, or personal limits can make simple issues feel heavier, so patience and realistic expectations matter.

mixed-testimony.headline: There is support here, along with real complications
mixed-testimony.body: Helpful and difficult patterns are both present. You may feel genuinely supported in some moments and challenged in others, so the relationship makes more sense when its different areas are considered separately.

neutral.headline: The relationship leaves more room for choice
neutral.body: No single classical pattern clearly dominates the whole connection. That gives your habits, decisions, and way of handling differences more influence over how the relationship develops.

mental-activation.headline: {{otherName}} draws your attention to ideas and words
mental-activation.body: With {{otherName}}, you may become more alert to conversation, explanations, and the way things are said. Your experience of the relationship can be strongly shaped by whether you feel mentally understood.

emotional-activation.headline: {{otherName}} makes your feelings harder to ignore
emotional-activation.body: Your emotional responses may become more noticeable around {{otherName}}. You can feel more protective, sensitive, comforted, or unsettled, depending on how the connection is unfolding.

relational-activation.headline: {{otherName}} makes the relationship itself feel important
relational-activation.body: Around {{otherName}}, you may pay closer attention to affection, attraction, fairness, and whether the bond feels mutual. The connection can make your expectations of partnership more visible to you.

practical-activation.headline: {{otherName}} brings practical realities to the front
practical-activation.body: Your experience of {{otherName}} may quickly connect with duties, timing, resources, or what can actually be sustained. You are likely to notice whether the relationship works beyond good intentions.

mixed-activation.headline: {{otherName}} brings out several different responses in you
mixed-activation.body: Your experience of {{otherName}} is not centered on one theme. Thoughts, feelings, attraction, and practical concerns may all become active, making the bond feel layered and sometimes hard to summarize.

flow.headline: Emotional responses tend to meet each other well
flow.body: There is a smoother pattern of emotional exchange here. It may be easier to offer reassurance, accept care, and recover a sense of closeness after ordinary stress.
Care is more likely to be recognized as care, which helps reassurance land.

difference.body: Different emotional habits still exist, but they are less likely to block connection.

friction.headline: Emotional needs can pull in different directions
friction.body: The bond may expose differences in comfort, timing, or emotional expression. Caring is possible, but it may take more patience to make sure support is offered in a form the other person can receive.

flow.body: Connection improves when care is made explicit instead of assumed.

difference.body: Under stress, one person's way of seeking comfort may press against the other's limits.

mixed.headline: Care is present, but the emotional fit varies
mixed.body: Some exchanges feel warm and responsive while others are less comfortable. The relationship can offer genuine closeness, though not every emotional need is likely to be met in the same way.

flow.body: Certain moments bring out a reliable sense of tenderness and support.

difference.body: Other moments reveal mismatched needs or different expectations of reassurance.

quiet.headline: The emotional bond may be subtle at first
quiet.body: The chart does not strongly emphasize emotional exchange on its own. Closeness may grow through steadiness, familiarity, and what you repeatedly do for each other rather than immediate intensity.

flow.body: Simple reliability can become a meaningful form of care.

difference.body: Emotional needs may need to be stated clearly because the bond may not surface them automatically.

flow.headline: Conversation has a workable rhythm
flow.body: It may be easier to exchange information, explain intentions, and return to the point after disagreement. Clear speech tends to help the relationship rather than complicate it.

friction.headline: Words can create more pressure than intended
friction.body: You may differ in how quickly you decide, explain, or respond. Misunderstanding can grow when either person assumes tone or wording carries more certainty than it actually does.

mixed.headline: Communication is strong in some areas and uneven in others
mixed.body: Certain subjects are easy to discuss, while others repeatedly expose different assumptions or ways of reasoning. The relationship benefits from knowing which conversations need extra care.

quiet.headline: Good communication will need to be built deliberately
quiet.body: The connection may not create an automatic rhythm of frequent or revealing conversation. Understanding grows more reliably when both people make a habit of explaining what they think and need.

flow.headline: Attraction is easier to express and receive
flow.body: Interest and warmth are more likely to move between you without excessive strain. The chemistry can feel pleasant, responsive, and easier to enjoy at a pace that suits both people.

friction.headline: Attraction can come with tension
friction.body: There may be strong interest alongside impatience, mismatch, or pressure. Chemistry is present, but it benefits from clear boundaries and enough time for both people to respond freely.

mixed.headline: The attraction has both ease and resistance
mixed.body: Some parts of the connection draw you together while others make one or both people hesitate. Chemistry can be meaningful without being simple or consistently expressed.

quiet.headline: Attraction may be gentle rather than immediate
quiet.body: The chart does not strongly emphasize obvious chemistry. Interest may grow through trust, familiarity, and consistent contact instead of a dramatic first pull.

received.headline: The bond has a strong basis for mutual support
received.body: There are signs that responsibility and support can be received rather than resisted. This can help the relationship carry commitments more comfortably, especially when expectations are made clear.

stability.body: Consistency is easier to accept when it feels supportive rather than controlling.

growth.body: Growth has more room when both people can recognize the value the other brings.

flow.headline: Long-term effort can settle into a steady rhythm
flow.body: There is a workable pattern for responsibility, continuity, and future planning. Commitment can grow through consistency without making the relationship feel unnecessarily heavy.

stability.body: Repeated follow-through helps trust become more durable over time.

growth.body: Future plans are easier to expand when the basic structure of the relationship feels dependable.

friction.headline: Commitment may feel heavier unless expectations are clear
friction.body: Responsibility, timing, or future plans can become sources of pressure. The relationship benefits from explicit agreements so that duty does not quietly turn into resentment.

stability.body: Stability improves when each person's responsibilities and limits are stated plainly.

growth.body: Growth can stall if new possibilities are treated as threats to existing obligations.

mixed.headline: The relationship can last, but it needs active adjustment
mixed.body: Some factors support continuity while others make long-term plans less straightforward. Commitment is more sustainable when you keep revisiting what each person can realistically give.

stability.body: Certain routines and promises can become dependable anchors.

growth.body: New directions may require adjusting older agreements rather than abandoning them.

quiet.headline: Longevity depends more on what you choose to maintain
quiet.body: The chart does not strongly push the relationship toward a particular long-term structure. If you want permanence, it will be built through deliberate reliability, shared priorities, and repeated choices.

stability.body: Consistency has to be created through practice rather than assumed from the start.

growth.body: The future becomes clearer when you decide together what deserves continued investment.

mixed.headline: You enter different parts of each other's lives
mixed.body: The house overlays show where each person is more likely to become personally significant in the other's life. Some areas may feel immediately active, while others remain quieter or more practical.

flow.headline: The strongest contacts offer useful support
flow.body: The most influential links between your charts tend to make cooperation, understanding, or continuity easier. These contacts give the relationship dependable places to draw from when other areas become difficult.

friction.headline: The strongest contacts bring real tests
friction.body: The most influential links between your charts are more demanding. They can create pressure, difference, or repeated points of negotiation, so the relationship benefits from patience and clear boundaries.

mixed.headline: The main contacts include both support and strain
mixed.body: Your strongest links do not point in only one direction. Some help the relationship hold together while others demand more work, so each major contact deserves to be read on its own terms.

quiet.headline: No single contact carries the whole relationship
quiet.body: There may be fewer dominant inter-chart aspects defining the bond. This leaves more room for the relationship to be shaped by smaller patterns, circumstances, and the choices you make over time.
